senses.en: The state of being economically successful and financially secure.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on economic prosperity.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济繁荣。

ex.en: The author returns to economic prosperity when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济繁荣。

tip: 不可数名词；形容词用prosperous。

senses.en: Made of or containing metal.

senses.zh: 有金属光泽、声音或味道的
senses.en: Resembling metal in appearance, sound, or taste.

ex.en: The textbook introduces metallic components in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了金属部件。

ex.en: The reading connects metallic components with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把金属部件和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a metallic sound｜金属般的声音
a metallic finish｜金属光泽饰面
tip: metallic既可指含金属，也可形容像金属的光泽或声音。

senses.en: Able to do many things or serve many different purposes.

ex.en: Our professor circled highly versatile on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了用途非常广泛的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly versatile.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕用途非常广泛的展开说明。

col: a versatile performer｜多才多艺的表演者
tip: 既可形容人多才多艺，也可形容物用途广泛。

senses.en: loss of the ability to move part or all of the body
a state in which action or progress becomes impossible

ex.en: Our professor circled temporary paralysis on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了暂时性瘫痪。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss temporary paralysis.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论暂时性瘫痪的材料。

tip: 既指身体瘫痪，也可比喻机构或决策陷入停滞。

senses.en: to supervise people taking an examination

ex.en: The lab instructions say to invigilate an exam.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求为考试监考。

ex.en: The passage says students who can invigilate an exam follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够为考试监考的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式英语常用 proctor。

senses.zh: 价格过高的；收费离谱的
senses.en: Much higher in price or cost than is reasonable.

ex.en: I copied exorbitant prices into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高得离谱的价格抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss exorbitant prices.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高得离谱的价格的材料。

tip: 比expensive语气更强，含不合理、过高之意。

senses.en: A curve winding around a centre or axis.
Curving around a centre or axis.
To move in curves, or increase or worsen rapidly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about downward spiral.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于不断恶化的局面的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects downward spiral with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把不断恶化的局面和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: spiral out of control｜急剧恶化至失控
tip: 英式过去式spiralled；美式spiraled，双写规则不同。

senses.en: Not required to follow a rule or fulfil an obligation.
To release someone from a rule, payment, or obligation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about exempt from tax.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于免税的的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to exempt from tax when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了免税的。

tip: 固定搭配：be exempt from；exempt sb from。

senses.en: To lead a formal meeting, ceremony, or other official event

ex.en: I heard the lecturer preside over a meeting during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时主持会议。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers preside over a meeting before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要主持会议。

col: preside over a meeting｜主持会议
preside at a ceremony｜主持典礼
tip: 不直接接会议等宾语，通常用preside over。

senses.en: To spread widely, or make light scatter in many directions.
Spread over a wide area rather than concentrated.
Using too many words without a clear focus.

ex.en: The assignment is to diffuse light, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使光线漫射，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to diffuse light.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使光线漫射。

tip: 动词词尾读/z/，形容词读/s/；勿混defuse（化解）。

senses.en: Someone who earns money to support a family.

ex.en: The professor explained bread-earner with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了挣钱养家的人。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses bread-earner when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了挣钱养家的人。

tip: 较少见；日常及考试写作通常用breadwinner。

senses.en: Careful to do duties thoroughly and correctly

ex.en: The textbook introduces a conscientious worker in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了尽责的员工。

ex.en: A campus survey used a conscientious worker to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用尽责的员工来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: conscientious about your work｜对工作认真负责
tip: conscientious是认真负责的；conscious是有意识的。

senses.en: To hide faults or wrongdoing so something appears acceptable.
An attempt to hide faults or wrongdoing.
A white liquid mixture used to coat walls.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to whitewash a scandal.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何掩盖丑闻。

ex.en: The passage says students who can whitewash a scandal follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够掩盖丑闻的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: a coat of whitewash｜一层石灰浆
tip: 比喻义带贬义，指掩饰问题，不是解决问题。

senses.en: a style or practice popular at a particular time

ex.en: Office hours began with the vogue for.
ex.zh: 答疑从对……的热潮开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used the vogue for to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用对……的热潮来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 常用in vogue表示“流行”；不是普通的可数物品。

senses.en: A serious effort to achieve something.
To try hard to achieve a goal.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a joint endeavour in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了共同的努力。

ex.en: The author returns to a joint endeavour when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了共同的努力。

col: endeavour to do something｜努力做某事
tip: 英式拼写；美式为endeavor；动词后接to do。

senses.en: protection that reduces the passage of heat, sound, or electricity
material used to limit heat, sound, or electricity passing through

ex.en: The textbook introduces thermal insulation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了隔热。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss thermal insulation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论隔热的材料。

tip: 通常不可数；可指隔绝作用，也可指所用材料。

senses.en: To close your hands or press your teeth together tightly.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to clench your fists.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何握紧双拳。

ex.en: The passage says students who can clench your fists follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够握紧双拳的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: clench指握紧或咬紧；clin​​ch才可指赢得、敲定。

senses.en: Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.

ex.en: The assignment is to acquaint yourself with, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使自己熟悉，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can acquaint yourself with follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够使自己熟悉的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 较正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。

senses.en: To join metal parts by heating their edges until they fuse.
The joint formed when metal parts are welded together.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to weld metal.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何焊接金属。

ex.en: The passage says students who can weld metal follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够焊接金属的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: weld A to B表示把A焊接到B上。

senses.en: a state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sense of serenity in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宁静感。

ex.en: The reading connects a sense of serenity with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把宁静感和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an atmosphere of serenity｜宁静的氛围
tip: 通常不可数，既形容环境宁静，也指内心平静。

senses.en: used in informal conversation rather than formal writing

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about colloquial language.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于口语化语言的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used colloquial language to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用口语化语言来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 指日常交谈中的非正式用语，不等于俚语。

senses.en: To understand a statement or action in a particular way.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer construe narrowly during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时作狭义解释。

ex.en: The passage says students who can construe narrowly follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够作狭义解释的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: construe something as｜将某事理解为
be construed as criticism｜被理解为批评
tip: 常用construe A as B，表示“把A理解为B”。

senses.en: To go beyond ordinary limits, differences, or expectations.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer transcend boundaries during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时超越界限。

ex.en: The reading asks you to transcend boundaries and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你超越界限，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: transcend cultural differences｜超越文化差异
transcend national interests｜超越国家利益
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加beyond。

senses.en: To seek private information about someone in an intrusive way.
To force something open or loose using a tool.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer pry into someone's affairs during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时打探某人的私事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can pry into someone's affairs follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够打探某人的私事的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: pry into someone's affairs｜打探某人的私事
pry open a lid｜撬开盖子
tip: 窥探用pry into；表示撬开时英式常用prise。

senses.en: The beginning of an activity, process, or period.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used outset in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了开始。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses outset when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了开始。

tip: 常用于at/from the outset，不用于set outset。

senses.en: to be a clear example of something
to explain something by giving examples

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to exemplify a trend.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何是某种趋势的典型。

ex.en: The passage says students who can exemplify a trend follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够是某种趋势的典型的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: exemplify a trend｜是某种趋势的典型
exemplify a principle｜例证某项原则
exemplify the benefits of｜体现…的益处
tip: 及物动词，直接接名词；举例时也可用be exemplified by。

senses.en: more important than anything else

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on paramount concern.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论首要关注的问题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of paramount concern.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得首要关注的问题这个例子。

tip: 常用be paramount或of paramount importance。

senses.en: A room used for a particular, often official, purpose.
An enclosed space inside a body, machine, or structure.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on council chamber.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论市议会会议厅。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around council chamber.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕市议会会议厅展开说明。

tip: chamber多指专用房间或封闭腔室，不是普通卧室。

senses.en: Relating to the cells of living organisms.
Using a mobile network divided into local coverage areas.

ex.en: The textbook introduces cellular structure in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了细胞结构。

ex.en: A campus survey used cellular structure to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用细胞结构来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: cellular network｜蜂窝移动通信网络
tip: 生物学中指细胞的；通信中指蜂窝网络的。

senses.en: Spending or costing much more money than necessary.
Going beyond what is reasonable or believable.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on extravagant spending.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论挥霍性支出。

ex.en: The reading connects extravagant spending with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把挥霍性支出和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既可指花钱无度，也可指言辞或要求过分。

senses.en: Inflammation of the liver, sometimes caused by a virus.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on viral hepatitis.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论病毒性肝炎。

ex.en: The author returns to viral hepatitis when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了病毒性肝炎。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；并非所有肝炎都由病毒引起。

senses.en: Careful not to reveal secrets or cause embarrassment.
Designed or chosen to avoid attracting attention.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a discreet enquiry.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论谨慎的询问。

ex.en: A campus survey used a discreet enquiry to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用谨慎的询问来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a discreet entrance｜不显眼的入口
tip: 勿混discrete（分离的）；discreet强调谨慎低调。

senses.en: Film storing very small photographic copies of documents.
To photograph documents at a greatly reduced size on film.

ex.en: Office hours began with a microfilm reader.
ex.zh: 答疑从缩微胶片阅读器开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a microfilm reader with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把缩微胶片阅读器和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a microfilm reader｜缩微胶片阅读器
tip: 表示以缩微胶片形式保存，用on microfilm。

senses.en: The combination of different ideas or elements into a whole.
The production of a substance by combining simpler substances.

ex.en: I copied chemical synthesis into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把化学合成抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to chemical synthesis when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了化学合成。

col: a synthesis of ideas｜思想的综合
tip: 复数为syntheses；常用a synthesis of。

senses.en: Not drunk or affected by alcohol.
Serious and sensible, or plain rather than bright.
To become or make someone less drunk or more serious.

ex.en: The textbook introduces sober assessment in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了冷静的评估。

ex.en: A campus survey used sober assessment to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用冷静的评估来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷静的判断。

senses.en: The act of speaking or acting on behalf of others.
A picture, description, or model showing someone or something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces legal representation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了法律代理。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around legal representation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕法律代理展开说明。

tip: 既可指替他人发声，也可指图像或文字对事物的呈现。

senses.en: To legally force someone to leave a property

ex.en: I heard the lecturer evict a tenant during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时驱逐租户。

ex.en: The reading asks you to evict a tenant and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你驱逐租户，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: evict someone from a property｜将某人逐出房产
tip: 常用evict somebody from；尤其指依法逐出租屋。

senses.en: the quality of lasting indefinitely without significant change

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sense of permanence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论长久稳定感。

ex.en: The author returns to a sense of permanence when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了长久稳定感。

col: a sense of permanence｜长久稳定感
tip: 不可数名词；形容词是permanent。

senses.en: To set a device or control before it is used.
Set or fixed before use.
A saved setting available for immediate use.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to preset the timer.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预设定时器。

ex.en: The reading asks you to preset the timer and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你预设定时器，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为preset；现在分词为presetting。

senses.en: Government policies restricting imports to protect domestic businesses from foreign competition.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on trade protectionism.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论贸易保护主义。

ex.en: A campus survey used trade protectionism to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用贸易保护主义来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: rising protectionism｜日益抬头的保护主义
resort to protectionism｜诉诸保护主义
tip: 不可数名词，特指贸易政策，不是一般的保护。

senses.en: the medical study and treatment of mental illnesses

ex.en: The textbook introduces a career in psychiatry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精神科职业生涯。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a career in psychiatry.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得精神科职业生涯这个例子。

col: a career in psychiatry｜精神科职业生涯
tip: 词首p不发音；精神科医生通常有医学资质。

senses.en: Someone who moves between places rather than living permanently somewhere

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about digital nomad.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于数字游民的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects digital nomad with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把数字游民和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: nomad通常作名词；形容词用nomadic。

senses.en: able to be done successfully in the circumstances

ex.en: I copied reasonably practicable into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把合理可行的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of reasonably practicable.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得合理可行的这个例子。

col: as soon as practicable｜在可行情况下尽快
tip: practicable强调可实施；practical还可指实用的。

senses.en: Become worse in quality, condition, or behaviour.
Having declined morally or lost normal structure or function.

ex.en: The assignment is to degenerate into, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先恶化为；演变成，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to degenerate into.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来恶化为；演变成。

tip: 动词尾音/reɪt/，形容词尾音/rət/；常接into。

senses.en: as a result of the action just mentioned

ex.en: The professor told us to thereby reducing costs and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们从而降低成本，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will thereby reducing costs when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会从而降低成本。

col: thereby reducing costs｜从而降低成本
thereby improving efficiency｜从而提高效率
tip: 常用逗号加thereby doing，说明前述行为的结果。

senses.en: Harm or damage caused to someone or something.

ex.en: I copied a detriment to health into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把对健康的不利因素抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a detriment to health when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了对健康的不利因素。

col: a detriment to health｜对健康的不利因素
tip: 最常见于to the detriment of，表示以损害……为代价。

senses.en: careless, improper, or illegal professional conduct, especially in medicine

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on medical malpractice.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医疗失当。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medical malpractice.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论医疗失当的材料。

tip: 多指专业人员失职，尤用于医疗，并非普通错误。

senses.en: proving something clearly and leaving no reasonable doubt

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about conclusive evidence.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于确凿证据的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around conclusive evidence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕确凿证据展开说明。

tip: 常修饰evidence或proof，不等于“最后的”。

senses.en: A tendency to remain inactive or resist change.
Matter's tendency to resist changes in its speed or direction.

ex.en: I copied institutional inertia into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把制度惰性抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to institutional inertia when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了制度惰性。

col: the inertia of an object｜物体的惯性
tip: 不可数名词：既指物理惯性，也指不愿改变的惰性。

senses.en: Discuss something with others before making a decision.
Officially give someone an honour, right, or benefit.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer confer with colleagues during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时与同事商议。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to confer with colleagues.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与同事商议。

col: confer a degree on someone｜授予某人学位
tip: 商议用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

senses.en: expressing strong hatred or a wish to hurt others
extremely unpleasant and deserving strong dislike

ex.en: Office hours began with hateful remarks.
ex.zh: 答疑从恶意言论开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hateful remarks.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论恶意言论的材料。

tip: 可形容充满仇恨的言行，也可指令人厌恶的事物。

senses.en: A clever action intended to gain an advantage.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on marketing ploy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论营销花招。

ex.en: The reading connects marketing ploy with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把营销花招和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常含耍花招之意，比普通的plan更有算计意味。

senses.en: A pressurised container that releases liquid as a fine spray.
Tiny solid particles or liquid droplets suspended in a gas.

ex.en: Our professor circled an aerosol can on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了喷雾罐。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of an aerosol can.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得喷雾罐这个例子。

tip: 日常可指喷雾罐；科学语境指气体中的悬浮微粒。

senses.en: Extremely worried or frightened and unable to stay calm
Done very quickly with intense, often uncontrolled activity

ex.en: The textbook introduces a frantic search in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了焦急的搜寻。

ex.en: The author returns to a frantic search when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了焦急的搜寻。

col: a frantic pace｜紧张忙乱的节奏
frantic with worry｜担心得心急如焚
tip: 强调焦急失控或忙乱，不等于精神失常。

senses.en: Objects made from a particular material or for a particular use.
Goods offered for sale, usually called wares.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about ceramic ware.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于陶瓷制品的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to ceramic ware when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了陶瓷制品。

col: sell one's wares｜出售自己的商品
tip: 指待售商品通常用wares；ware常见于复合词。

senses.en: extremely careful and thorough
demanding strict effort or obedience to rules

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rigorous testing.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论严格测试。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rigorous testing.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严格测试的材料。

tip: 研究、测试用它强调严谨；训练、标准强调严格。

senses.zh: 无正当理由的；无根据的
senses.en: not justified by the facts or circumstances

ex.en: Our professor circled unwarranted criticism on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了无端的批评。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unwarranted criticism.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕无端的批评展开说明。

tip: 强调缺乏依据或正当理由，不只是“不需要”。

senses.en: Widely known and admired for a particular quality or achievement.

ex.en: Office hours began with internationally renowned.
ex.zh: 答疑从享有国际声誉的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around internationally renowned.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕享有国际声誉的展开说明。

tip: renowned for接成就或特色；renowned as接身份。

senses.en: To express strong disapproval of someone or something.
To officially give someone a severe punishment.
To officially declare a building unsafe to use.

ex.en: The assignment is to condemn a building, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先宣告建筑不宜使用，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to condemn a building.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得宣告建筑不宜使用。

col: condemn someone to prison｜判某人入狱
condemn a building｜宣告建筑不宜使用
tip: 词尾n不发音；别与表示“冷凝”的condense混淆。

senses.en: A person or company that owns ships.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about private shipowner.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于私人船主的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of private shipowner.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得私人船主这个例子。

tip: 指拥有船的人或公司，不等于驾驶船的船长。

senses.en: small balls of ice that fall from clouds
to fall from the sky as small balls of ice
to praise someone publicly or call to attract attention

ex.en: Office hours began with heavy hail.
ex.zh: 答疑从猛烈的冰雹开始。

ex.en: The author returns to heavy hail when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了猛烈的冰雹。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
be hailed as a breakthrough｜被誉为一项突破
tip: 下冰雹用it hails；hail A as B指称赞A为B。

senses.en: A weapon that fires bullets using an explosive charge.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about firearm safety.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于枪支安全的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around firearm safety.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕枪支安全展开说明。

tip: 可数名词，常见复数firearms，语体较正式。

senses.en: payment received for work or services

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fair remuneration.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公平的报酬。

ex.en: The author returns to fair remuneration when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公平的报酬。

tip: 正式用语，通常不可数，指工作报酬而非损害赔偿。

senses.en: A bluish-white metal also needed in small amounts for health.

ex.en: Office hours began with zinc deficiency.
ex.zh: 答疑从缺锌开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used zinc deficiency to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用缺锌来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 锌是化学元素，符号Zn；作物质名通常不可数。

senses.en: To reach a goal or level, usually through effort.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to attain a goal.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求实现目标。

ex.en: The passage says students who can attain a goal follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够实现目标的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: attain a high standard｜达到高标准
tip: 正式及物动词，直接接目标或水平，不加to。

senses.en: Small water drops forming on cool surfaces, especially overnight

ex.en: Office hours began with morning dew.
ex.zh: 答疑从晨露开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss morning dew.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论晨露的材料。

tip: dew通常不可数；一滴露水用a drop of dew。

senses.en: To prevent a feeling or physical reaction from being expressed.
To stop an activity or opposition, often using force.
To prevent information from becoming known or being published.

ex.en: The professor asked us to suppress a smile.
ex.zh: 教授让我们忍住笑。

ex.en: The reading asks you to suppress a smile and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你忍住笑，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 及物动词，直接接情绪、反应、活动或信息。

senses.en: Selling goods abroad below normal value, often harming local producers
Leaving unwanted material somewhere, often illegally or carelessly

ex.en: Office hours began with illegal dumping.
ex.zh: 答疑从非法倾倒开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss illegal dumping.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论非法倾倒的材料。

tip: 贸易中指低于正常价值的出口销售，并非所有降价促销。

senses.en: Using clever, original ideas to solve problems or make things.

ex.en: Our professor circled an ingenious solution on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了巧妙的解决办法。

ex.en: The reading connects an ingenious solution with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把巧妙的解决办法和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an ingenious solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip: 勿混淆：ingenious是巧妙的，ingenuous是天真的。

senses.en: To free people or places from control or imprisonment.
To release someone from restrictions that limit their life.

ex.en: The professor asked us to liberate a country.
ex.zh: 教授让我们解放一个国家。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to liberate a country.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们解放一个国家。

col: liberate a country｜解放一个国家
liberating experience｜令人感到自由的经历
tip: 及物动词；liberate A from B表示使A摆脱B。

senses.en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a group

ex.en: The textbook introduces boost morale in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了鼓舞士气。

ex.en: The reading connects boost morale with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把鼓舞士气和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 不可数；morale指士气，moral指道德的。

senses.en: Education received at school.

ex.en: Our professor circled formal schooling on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了正规学校教育。

ex.en: The author returns to formal schooling when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了正规学校教育。

col: years of schooling｜受学校教育的年数
tip: schooling通常不可数，侧重在校接受的教育。

senses.en: Expected to happen very soon.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on imminent danger.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迫在眉睫的危险。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around imminent danger.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕迫在眉睫的危险展开说明。

tip: 强调即将发生，不等于urgent（需紧急处理）。

senses.en: Required to be paid at a specified time
Intended to be paid to a particular person or organisation

ex.en: Our professor circled payable in advance on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了须预付的。

ex.en: A campus survey used payable in advance to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用须预付的来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: payable in instalments｜可分期支付的
tip: payable to后接收款人；payable in后可接币种。

senses.en: a small group of trees, often planted together

ex.en: Our professor circled olive grove on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了橄榄园。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss olive grove.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论橄榄园的材料。

col: a grove of trees｜一片小树林
tip: grove是一小片树木，常用于橄榄、柑橘等果树林。

senses.en: Working carefully and consistently with strong effort

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about diligent student.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于勤奋的学生的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of diligent student.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得勤奋的学生这个例子。

col: diligent in one's work｜工作认真尽责
tip: 不仅指努力，也强调认真、细致和持续投入。

senses.en: To spread ideas, beliefs, or information among people.
To produce new plants or organisms from existing ones.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer propagate ideas during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时传播观念。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to propagate ideas.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来传播观念。

col: propagate from cuttings｜通过扦插繁殖
tip: 既可指传播观念，也可指繁殖植物；语体较正式。

senses.en: relating to amounts that can be measured or counted

ex.en: Office hours began with quantitative research.
ex.zh: 答疑从定量研究开始。

ex.en: The author returns to quantitative research when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了定量研究。

tip: quantitative 重数量测量；qualitative 重性质描述。

senses.en: Using more words than are needed to express something.

ex.en: Office hours began with overly wordy.
ex.zh: 答疑从过于冗长的开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used overly wordy to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用过于冗长的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 通常含贬义，指用词过多，而非词汇丰富。

senses.en: a device that controls nuclear reactions to produce energy
a container in which controlled chemical reactions take place

ex.en: Office hours began with nuclear reactor.
ex.zh: 答疑从核反应堆开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear reactor.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核反应堆这个例子。

tip: 能源话题中常指核反应堆；化工中也指反应器。

senses.en: The deliberate killing of many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.
To deliberately kill many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a brutal massacre.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于残酷的大屠杀的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a brutal massacre to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用残酷的大屠杀来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

col: a brutal massacre｜残酷的大屠杀
commemorate a massacre｜纪念大屠杀事件
tip: 指大规模残杀，语气极重；勿用于一般伤亡事件。

senses.en: To signal that something new or important is coming.
A sign of something approaching, or an official messenger.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to herald a new era.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预示新时代的到来。

ex.en: When the class discussed public communication, the speaker told us to herald a new era.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共传播时，讲者让我们预示新时代的到来。

col: herald a new era｜预示新时代的到来
herald the arrival of｜预示……的到来
be heralded as a breakthrough｜被誉为突破
tip: 不是副词；be heralded as意为“被誉为”。

senses.en: relating to punishment for breaking rules
relating to a particular field of academic study

ex.en: I copied disciplinary action into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把纪律处分抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects disciplinary action with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把纪律处分和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常见于disciplinary action，指纪律处分措施。

senses.en: A large farm growing crops such as tea, coffee, or cotton.
An area where trees are planted together, often for timber.

ex.en: The textbook introduces tea plantation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了茶叶种植园。

ex.en: The author returns to tea plantation when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了茶叶种植园。

tip: 通常指大面积种植单类作物的农场，不是普通花园。

senses.en: to copy someone's behaviour or reproduce something's features
a person skilled at copying other people's voices or behaviour

ex.en: The assignment is to mimic someone's voice, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先模仿某人的声音，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers mimic someone's voice before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要模仿某人的声音。

col: mimic someone's voice｜模仿某人的声音
mimic natural processes｜模拟自然过程
a talented mimic｜有天赋的模仿者
tip: 过去式mimicked，进行时mimicking，均加k。

senses.en: Containing many carefully arranged details or parts.
To explain something further by adding more details.

ex.en: The textbook introduces an elaborate design in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精细的设计。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an elaborate design.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论精细的设计的材料。

col: an elaborate plan｜周密复杂的计划
elaborate on a point｜详细阐述某一点
tip: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；elaborate on表示详细阐述。

senses.en: The study of forces and how objects move
The practical details of how something works or is done

ex.en: The textbook introduces classical mechanics in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经典力学。

ex.en: A campus survey used classical mechanics to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经典力学来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: the mechanics of voting｜投票的具体操作流程
tip: 指力学时用单数谓语；指操作细节时用复数谓语。

senses.en: A man skilled in practical work such as plumbing or carpentry.
A man who buys and sells goods, especially a shopkeeper.

ex.en: Office hours began with a skilled tradesman.
ex.zh: 答疑从熟练技工开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a skilled tradesman when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟练技工。

col: a qualified tradesman｜有资质的技工
tip: 复数为tradesmen；性别中性表达用tradesperson。

senses.en: Showing great courage, especially when helping others
Involving extraordinary effort or determination

ex.en: The textbook introduces heroic act in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了英勇行为。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss heroic act.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论英勇行为的材料。

tip: heroic effort强调付出极大努力，不一定涉及危险。

senses.en: a violin, especially when used for folk music
keep moving or touching something without a clear purpose
dishonestly change information to gain an advantage

ex.en: After the lecture, we used fiddle in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了小提琴。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up fiddle while discussing evidence about the humanities.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人文学科的证据时提到了小提琴。

col: fiddle with a pen｜摆弄钢笔
tip: 指小提琴时较口语；fiddle with表示摆弄。

senses.en: to use something effectively for a particular purpose

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to utilise resources.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须利用资源。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to utilise resources.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得利用资源。

tip: 英式拼写，也写作utilize；日常表达常用use。

senses.en: to greatly reduce the amount of something available

ex.en: The professor asked us to deplete resources.
ex.zh: 教授让我们消耗资源。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to deplete resources.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来消耗资源。

col: deplete energy reserves｜消耗能量储备
tip: 强调存量大幅减少，不一定完全耗尽。

senses.en: relating to plans for achieving important long-term goals
especially useful for gaining an advantage

ex.en: Our professor circled strategic planning on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了战略规划。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around strategic planning.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕战略规划展开说明。

tip: strategic重整体长远规划，tactical重具体战术。

senses.en: Force someone or something to move away.
Push something away or prevent it from being absorbed.
Make someone feel strong dislike or disgust.

ex.en: The assignment is to repel insects, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先驱虫，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to repel insects and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你驱虫，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 过去式 repelled，动名词 repelling，双写l。

senses.en: The owner of a business, such as a shop or hotel.

ex.en: Our professor circled sole proprietor on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了独资经营者。

ex.en: The author returns to sole proprietor when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了独资经营者。

tip: 较正式，常指商店、旅馆等生意的所有者。

senses.en: To take in and fully understand new information or ideas.
To become, or make someone become, part of a cultural group.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to assimilate information.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何吸收信息。

ex.en: The passage says students who can assimilate information follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够吸收信息的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 知识可直接作宾语；融入群体常用into。

senses.en: poor health caused by insufficient or unbalanced nutrients

ex.en: Office hours began with suffer from malnutrition.
ex.zh: 答疑从患营养不良开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used suffer from malnutrition to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用患营养不良来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 不可数；不仅指吃得少，也包括营养摄入失衡。

senses.en: A hospital or room providing medical care within an institution.

ex.en: Office hours began with school infirmary.
ex.zh: 答疑从学校医务室开始。

ex.en: The reading connects school infirmary with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把学校医务室和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常指机构内的医务室；英国部分医院也用此名。

senses.en: To start a fire or begin to burn.
To cause a feeling or interest to develop.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to kindle a fire.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求生火。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to kindle a fire.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来生火。

tip: 较正式或文学化；既能点火，也能激起兴趣。

senses.en: In a way that expresses sadness or disappointment about something.

ex.en: The professor told us to regretfully decline and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们遗憾地谢绝，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior asks the class to regretfully decline before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先遗憾地谢绝。

tip: regretfully强调人的遗憾；regrettably评价事情可惜。
